order: Write up the tenth delta review in this long-running series. Pair the order with the account of what its executor found, covering the round-5e fixes anchored to the two commits marking where round-5d ends and this round begins. Cite that pair as the specific boundary rather than folding it into a shared range, and place both files as wholly new additions under the roster directory, so the tree elsewhere stays untouched and nothing on file gets rewritten. Hold the scope to exactly that pinned pair, not the string of rounds behind it, since this pass answers only for what those two commits changed. State, as a standalone sentence, that only a clean verdict against that pair moves the two pending work orders out of revise. A partial or qualified result changes nothing about where those orders stand today.
claims: The order and its companion account went in under roster as two new files. They add up to one hundred eighteen lines together, and no deletion touches any other file in the tree, while the two pinned commits are cited as that specific pair. Only a clean verdict against exactly that pair moves the two pending work orders out of revise, and nothing less does. The write-up treats that fact as the pass's single deliverable outcome, with nothing additional claimed beyond it.
